title: Minimum Size Usage
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose artwork at the intended output size. The relationship between detail and scale changes what a reader can distinguish.
strategic_value: Dedicated regular and large drawings can keep the lab’s signature legible in print and digital placements.
demonstration: Two marks appear at different sizes, with bracketed labels for the 90-point regular minimum and the 3.5-inch threshold for the large drawing.
practical_value: For web use choose the regular artwork. For print check the width against the regular minimum and the large-version threshold, and request special artwork for the stated 85-point exception.

content_islands.name: Selection guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the print, web and exception guidance in the left rail.

content_islands.name: Size comparison
content_islands.spec: Show the regular and large marks on a common pale field. Align the width brackets and the Regular and Large labels below the specimens.
